experiment: decomposition of the ensemble gain + partial-only push
why: Resolution diversity alone adds only +0.003. The partial-correlation representation is where the signal lives: partial-only reaches 0.6386 (10 seeds) / 0.6365 (25 seeds) while adding the full-correlation blocks DILUTES it by about 0.004.
margin: +0.0095 (1.2 SE) — a larger and more stable margin than the previous 12-block result (0.6320, +0.005)
caveat: The literature number is Schaefer-400; this is ICA. The parcellation caveat still applies.
